summary: Medalist Diversified, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on September 1, 2026, its wholly owned subsidiary MDI Mira Sav, LLC formed the Mira JV with Spandrel Development Partners and other investors, including CEO Frank Kavanaugh and director Emanuel Neuman. Medalist committed $4.0 million for an approximately 42% preferred equity interest, with Spandrel holding 37% and each insider 11% common equity. The JV is managed by Spandrel, which controls operations. Medalist receives a 6% current preferred return plus 9% accrued preferred return paid at exit, and retains approval rights over major decisions and manager-removal rights upon material adverse events. The operating partnership will provide a limited guaranty for an approximately $13.5 million construction loan expected to close within 30 days. The board approved the related-party transaction, with Kavanaugh and Neuman recused. Watch for construction loan closing and potential conflicts from insider participation.
